title: streaming-lifecycle-controls-client-cancel-disconnect-reconnect-resume-timeouts
author: Maya Patel
description: Add end-to-end streaming lifecycle controls to improve robustness for client-side cancellations, unexpected disconnects, reconnect/resume behavior, and server-side idle/request timeouts while maintaining OpenAI-compat API semantics. This PR centralizes lifecycle state transitions in the streaming runtime, exposes graceful cancel semantics to SDKs, implements reconnect token + resume offset for short-lived disconnects, adds server-side inactivity and per-request deadline handling with clear disconnect reasons emitted to clients, and updates the OpenAI compatibility layer to preserve existing event ordering and error codes. Includes unit and e2e tests, SDK surface annotations, docs updates, and operational metrics to track cancel/reconnect rates.
commits: Initial implementation of lifecycle state machine and reconnect token handling
Add server-side timeout handling and cancel propagation
Wire up OpenAI-compat event format and preserve old event ordering
Add e2e tests for reconnect/resume and flaky network scenarios
Address review comments: tighten invariants, add metrics and more tests

Lena Kovacs: Thread-safety nit: lifecycle transitions should use the existing runtime lock instead of a new mutex to avoid deadlocks during shutdown.
Maya Patel (author): Switched to runtime's lifecycle lock and added a regression test that exercised shutdown during reconnects.
Diego Ramirez: CI flake on e2e test 'reconnect-resume-happy-path' — looks like a timing assumption; please make test tolerant to slight delays.
Maya Patel (author): Made test use event-driven resume confirmation instead of fixed sleep. CI rerun passed.
Ethan Chen: Approve after addressing metrics naming and adding docs noting OpenAI compat guarantees.
Lena Kovacs: LGTM. Leaving minor comment about log verbosity for follow-up.

release_notes: Improved streaming robustness: client-initiated cancel propagation, graceful disconnect handling, reconnect+resume support, server-side request/inactivity timeouts, OpenAI compatibility preserved. SDKs updated to expose cancel and resume hooks. Operational metrics added to monitor cancellations and reconnects.
